**Business Analyst (Contract)**

 *Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Microsoft through external staffing partners of Allegis Global Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by AGS and will not be an employee of Microsoft.*

 **Summary:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytically driven Business Operations Specialist to join a high\-performing team responsible for supporting sales partners in managing and maintaining client books of business. In this fully remote, staff augmentation role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy of organizational data, client alignment, and segment integrity across internal systems. A typical day involves partnering with Sales, Operations, and Business Analytics teams to process and validate data changes that support critical sales planning activities — reviewing datasets, reconciling discrepancies, troubleshooting escalations, and ensuring the accuracy of account, territory, quota, and organizational data. You will collaborate with stakeholders across global regions, support reporting and analysis requests, and contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and data quality. This role combines analytical problem\-solving, operational execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment handling approximately 1,000 change requests per fiscal year.

 **Job Responsibilities:**

* Review and approve contracts, cost proposals, and contract supplements to ensure compliance and accuracy
* Approve project and work breakdown structures in alignment with organizational goals
* Review, document, and approve business process documentation
* Approve project budgets and expenditures, and monitor transaction controls and costs against budgets
* Predict potential budget overruns and proactively offer data\-driven solutions
* Process and validate high\-volume data change requests including book and client updates, personnel changes, and LOA processing
* Reconcile data discrepancies and resolve escalations within internal systems
* Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Business Analytics teams to support sales planning activities
* Support reporting and analysis requests using tools such as Excel and Power BI
* Consult with project managers, auditors, client representatives, and cross\-functional stakeholders regarding proposals and operational needs
* Prepare sub\-agreements and review sub\-consultant invoices to ensure contract compliance
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance data quality and operational efficiency

 **Requirements:**

* 8–10 years of experience in business operations, sales operations, analytics, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-volume change requests or operational workflows
* Background in sales planning, business operations, marketing analytics, or digital advertising strongly preferred
* Proven track record of driving process improvements and supporting strategic business initiatives
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional and globally distributed stakeholder teams
* Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a relevant field required
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, PivotTables, data validation, and large dataset management
* Strong data analysis and reporting capabilities using tools such as Power BI and SQL
* Solid understanding of business and management principles including strategic planning, resource allocation, and production methods
* Ability to analyze business trends and project future revenues and expenses
* Strong application of accounting and mathematical principles in an operational context
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and operate with minimal supervision
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills across global and cross\-functional teams
* Self\-resourceful, quick learner with the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience with enterprise applications and operational ticketing or change management systems

* Location: Remote
* Duration: 18 months

jobs.title: Program Manager, Global Workforce Strategy (Contract)
jobs.description:
US \- Remote
People
Remote
Contract
\*\* This is a contract role. **Duration**: suggested 6 months, with an option to extend. **Hours:** 20\-30 per week\*\*  

  

**Company Overview**
--------------------


Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.  

  

We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.  

  

**Role**
--------

As Function Health expands globally, with active hiring in LATAM, momentum in the UK, and plans for further international growth, we are establishing a strategic foundation to support our international workforce. To ensure long\-term success, we are proactively designing a scalable, compliant, and optimized global operating model.  

  

We are seeking a contractor to lead our global workforce strategy workstream. In this role, you will serve as the project manager and strategic connective tissue across People, Legal, Finance, Tax, and business leadership. You will build comprehensive cost\-benefit analyses to identify the optimal engagement model for each market, drive key strategic decisions to closure, and establish a clear, repeatable framework that empowers our team to scale sustainably for the future.  

  

This is a hands\-on delivery role, not an advisory one. Success looks like decisions made, guardrails published, and a repeatable playbook in place by the end of the engagement.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the global workforce strategy work stream end to end \- scope, plan, milestones, risks, and status reporting to leadership.
* Build a comprehensive cost\-benefit analysis across our international footprint, covering contractor\-to\-EOR conversions, new EOR implementations, and the threshold at which standing up a legal entity is the better long\-term investment.
* Develop a scalable decision framework for choosing between contractor, EOR, and entity models, weighted for cost, compliance risk, speed, candidate experience, and long\-term operating complexity.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across People, Legal, Finance, Tax, and business leaders \- surfacing tradeoffs, forcing the open questions, and getting to a decision rather than another meeting.
* Support UK expansion, including evaluation and potential entity creation, on a timeline that lands before year\-end.
* Partner with engineering leadership on LATAM hiring plans, giving them the data and framework to evaluate tradeoffs before commitments are made.
* Define clear guardrails and operating principles for contractor engagements including eligibility for employee programs, benefits, and equity.
* Establish lightweight governance: intake process, decision rights, escalation path, and turnaround expectations, so requests stop being handled reactively.
* Document everything and run a clean handoff \- playbooks, templates, and decision logs that outlast the engagement.
  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 7\+ years in program or project management with direct ownership of international workforce, global mobility and expansion, or global HR operations initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience with EOR platforms and implementations, contractor engagement models, and the economics and mechanics of establishing legal entities in a new market.
* Working knowledge of the risk landscape: worker classification, permanent establishment, payroll and employment tax, work authorization, benefits, and statutory requirements.
* Direct experience working with LATAM and the UK markets.
* Strong financial modeling instincts. Able to build a defensible fully\-loaded cost comparison across models and markets, and explain it to a CFO.
* Proven ability to drive alignment and decisions across senior stakeholders without formal authority.
* Crisp written communication; comfortable writing the exec memo and the operating doc with equal quality.
* Ability to move fast in an ambiguous, high\-growth environment and bring structure without adding bureaucracy.
  

  

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry
* Prior work at a company scaling from first international hires to a multi\-entity footprint.
* Familiarity with equity administration across contractor and EOR populations.
  

  

**To be a strong fit, you embody our Core Values**
--------------------------------------------------


* Ruthless Prioritization:
	+ We don’t let perfect get in the way of progress.
	+ We move quickly to drive value, not perfection.
	+ We prioritize what drives impact.
	+ We never compromise on standards of excellence.
*

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Concordia Consulting Group (CCG) is a private, small business based in the Washington, DC, area. CCG was founded in 2024, specializing in providing innovative business solutions and expert consulting services to federal government agencies. With a commitment to delivering exceptional results, we collaborate with organizations to streamline operations, enhance efficiency, and drive growth. We value professionalism, adaptability, and a client\-first approach to ensure sustainable success. Joining Concordia means becoming part of a company that fosters collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

**Position Overview**

CCG is seeking an experienced Project Manager to support the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Section 508 Support Services task order. The DHS Office of the Chief Information Officer, Experience and Accessibility Directorate (EAD) sets the Department's vision and strategic direction for ensuring that all Information and Communications Technology (ICT) procured, maintained, or used by DHS is accessible to employees and customers with disabilities. In this role, you will serve as the single point of contact to the Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer's Representative, direct all contractor support work performed under the Statement of Work, and manage the schedule, staffing, deliverables, and reporting that keep the Section 508 program running across the Department.

**Responsibilities**

* **Government Interface:** Serve as the single point of contact for the Contracting Officer and the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), remain available by telephone between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. EST Monday through Friday, and respond to requests to discuss or resolve technical problems within 24 hours of notification.
* **Reporting:** Provide a monthly progress report to the Contracting Officer and COR by the 15th day of the following month, summarizing all contractor work performed, labor hours by category, direct costs by line item, technical progress, schedule status, and any contractor concerns or recommendations.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Meet virtually with the COR and other designated federal personnel to present deliverables, discuss progress, exchange information, and resolve emergent technical issues.
* **Events and Outreach:** Support events and activities requiring presentations or contractor presence, ensuring all materials are prepared, delivered, accessible, and retrieved efficiently.
* **Deliverable Quality and Compliance:** Ensure all written reports and deliverables are accurate, on time, Section 508 conformant, and compatible with DHS workstations and Microsoft Office applications, and ensure contractor personnel understand and follow DHS rules, regulations, and policies governing conduct, safety, and security.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Minimum of three years of experience managing projects of similar size and complexity.
* Experience managing federal government contracts or task orders and serving as the primary point of contact to a Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer's Representative.
* Demonstrated experience producing standard project management deliverables, including project plans, staffing plans, business continuity plans, and recurring monthly progress and status reports.
* Experience planning, staffing, and managing distributed or fully remote technical teams, including recruitment, retention, and replacement of personnel.
* Working knowledge of Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, the Revised Section 508 Standards (36 CFR Part 1194\), and WCAG 2\.0 Level A and AA success criteria as they apply to ICT.
* Ability to track cost, schedule, and technical performance and report status clearly to both technical staff and senior government leadership.
* Ability to produce written deliverables that meet Section 508 standards for electronic content, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
* Experience supporting a DHS component or another federal Office of the Chief Information Officer, particularly an IT accessibility or Section 508 program.
* Familiarity with the DHS Trusted Tester program, the DHS Section 508 Playbook, or IAAP certifications such as CPACC or WAS.
* Experience with ServiceNow\-based ticketing and reporting platforms, such as the Accessibility Compliance Management System (ACMS).
* Experience supporting IT governance and acquisition review processes, such as IT Acquisition Reviews (ITARs) or change control boards

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent certifications. Advanced degree (MS/PhD) strongly preferred.

**Clearance Requirements**

U.S. Citizenship

**Work Location**

Remote

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is $95,000 \- $125,000\. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

**Benefits Overview**

Concordia Consulting Group is committed to providing its employees with competitive salaries and benefits in order to increase employee satisfaction and productivity.

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance
* 401k matching

**Concordia Consulting Group Important Information**

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verif

This position will be fully remote and will operate at the enterprise level, coordinating multiple workstreams and cross\-functional teams. The Lead serves as the primary authority for program execution, responsible for portfolio\-level delivery, Program Increment (PI) planning alignment, and ensuring measurable value across all contributing teams. This role generally reports to a Program Manager.

* Coordinates across teams to manage dependencies, improve communication, and ensure delivery of measurable outcomes.

Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) with 12\+ years of progressive experience in clinical informatics, healthcare program management, or digital health transformation.

**Clearance Required**: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

jobs.description:
9th Way Insignia is a service\-disabled, veteran\-owned small business bringing transformative technology to our government customers so they can achieve their missions. Our specialties include cybersecurity, cloud modernization, software development, data analytics, enterprise architecture, enterprise IT, analytics, process automation, and artificial intelligence. Learn more about 9th Way Insignia at https://9thwayinsignia.com/.



Application password: Niner

**Team (Project) Introduction**



We are recruiting for a range of cybersecurity opportunities supporting federal customers, focused on strengthening enterprise security architecture, systems engineering, and the secure implementation of technologies across the environment.



The work involves applying established cybersecurity standards, guidelines, and frameworks to help translate organizational and business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions. Team members may contribute to security architecture and engineering efforts, implementation guidance, technical analysis, and the development of repeatable approaches that support the consistent deployment and operation of secure technologies across complex enterprise environments.



Systems security engineering is an important component of this work, with an emphasis on incorporating security and stakeholder protection requirements throughout the system development life cycle, from concept and design through development, production, sustainment, and decommissioning. The team will apply established systems engineering and cybersecurity principles to help protect systems, applications, data, and supporting technologies.



Ultimately, this work supports the broader mission to strengthen its cybersecurity posture, reduce organizational risk, and protect critical systems and information from evolving cyber threats, including external adversaries and insider threats.



9th Way Insignia is looking for a Program Manager to join this team.  

  

**Professional Level Information:**  

A Manager at 9th Way Insignia accomplishes department objectives by managing staff and processes and evaluating department activities. A Manager is responsible for planning, directing and overseeing the operations and fiscal health of a unit, division, or department. jobs.description:
Prysmian is the world leader in the energy and telecom cable systems industry. Each year, the company manufactures thousands of miles of underground and submarine cables and systems for power transmission and distribution, as well as medium low voltage cables for the construction and infrastructure sectors. We also produce a comprehensive range of optical fibers, copper cables and connectivity for voice, video and data transmission for the telecommunication sector.


We are 30,000 employees, across 50\+ countries. Everyone at Prysmian has the potential to make their mark; because whatever you do, wherever you are based, you will be part of a company that is helping transform the world around us.


Make Your Mark at Prysmian!


**Position Summary:**

The Regional Manufacturing Learning \& Development Specialist will lead the deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement of the Dozuki digital work instruction and training platform across manufacturing facilities in North America. This role partners with Operations, Continuous Improvement, HR, and plant leadership teams to standardize work instructions, enhance workforce training, and support digital transformation initiatives.

This is a highly visible position with opportunities to collaborate with manufacturing leaders across approximately 30 facilities throughout the United States and Canada. jobs.title: Project Manager - Infor ERP
jobs.description:
Join the company that is leading the business sustainability revolution. Be a part of an incredibly talented, dedicated, dynamic, and creative team. At PCG our consultants, practice leaders, and customer support advocates are the best in the industry. We know that when you surround yourself with the best, you achieve success – success for our customers.


PCG is a trusted provider of tailored end\-to\-end IT solutions that consistently and predictably deliver business sustainability. PCG is a company built on relationships, partnerships, and experiences. We offer a single point of accountability. We have tremendous resources and capabilities in place to care for every aspect of a customer’s technology environment—from the back office to edge apps to the cloud and across the entire supply and demand chain. Whether it’s enterprise application cloud and hosting solutions or enterprise application (ERP) implementation and management, partner with our customers for success.

PCG Project Manager's are part of our Infor ERP LN Practice and provide thought leadership through business consulting services to our customers focusing on business process transformation within various industries. The Project Manager will help our customers develop a singular process transform workstream to centralize and drive toward a standard adoption. This will include a process of design, training of process, and organizational/role mapping to methods.

* Validates the effective planning and availability of all PCG resources
* Provide weekly customer timesheet report

* Understands the project business objectives and have a clear vision of how to achieve those objectives

* ERP Project Management experience and knowledge of ERP solution, previous PM experience with Infor LN ERP is preferred
* Successfully acted as an advisor and built relationships among stakeholder community
* Experience managing upward among senior leadership

jobs.description:
**Crossroads Treatment Centers is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Since 2005, Crossroads has been at the forefront of treating patients with opioid use disorder. Crossroads is a family of professionals dedicated to providing the most accessible, highest quality, evidence\-based medication assisted treatment (MAT) options to combat the growing opioid epidemic and helping people with opioid use disorder start their path to recovery. This comprehensive approach to treatment, the gold standard in care for opioid use disorder, has been shown to prevent more deaths from overdose and lead to long\-term recovery. We are committed to bringing critical services to communities across the U.S. to improve access to treatment for over 26,500 patients. Our clinics are all outpatient and office\-based, with clinics in Georgia, Kentucky, New Jersey, North and South Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees and patients.


***Day in the Life of a Remote Workday Intelligence Analyst***
==============================================================

**Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Workday HCM, Talent, Timekeeping, Benefits, Payroll, Reporting, and Integrations.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

***Key Responsibilities***
==========================

* **Develop, maintain, and distribute standard and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and workforce analytics**.
* Configure, maintain, test, and troubleshoot Workday business processes, security roles, reports, dashboards, and system functionality.
* Partner with People Operations, Finance, Operations, Payroll, Benefits, and IT teams to understand business needs and recommend system solutions.
* Support Workday releases, enhancements, system updates, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist with the management and monitoring of Workday integrations and data interfaces.
* Maintain data integrity and ensure compliance with regulatory, organizational, and security requirements.
* Analyze workforce data and trends to support business decision\-making.
* Participate in system implementations, upgrades, testing, and project\-related activities.
* Research and recommend process improvements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and user experience.
* Provide end\-user support, troubleshooting, and training for Workday functionality.
* Create and maintain system documentation, job aids, and training materials.
* Collaborate with internal and external partners to resolve system issues and support organizational objectives.
* Research, identify, and drive opportunities to streamline and simplify existing processes and practices.
* Communicate with users, key stakeholders and leadership regarding system issues, enhancements, upgrades/releases, etc. as required.

***Preferred Education \& Experience***
=======================================

* Bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) from an accredited college or university, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, or Business\-related field preferred.
* At least two years' experience as a HR systems analyst or holds at least 2 active Workday Pro Certifications in the following areas: HCM, Recruiting, Benefits, Absence/Timekeeping.
* Experience supporting multiple Workday modules, including: HCM, Benefits, Payroll, Timekeeping, Talent, Integrations, and Reporting/Analytics.
* Advanced Excel skills.
* Must be analytical; detail oriented and understands/considers the downstream impact of configuration and business process changes.
* The individual must have problem solving skills and be able to apply creative solutions to potential problems.
* Project management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
* Must have excellent time management skills in meeting deadlines.
* Exercises considerable judgment and discretion in preparing and handling information of a sensitive nature.

***Benefits Package***
======================

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* PTO
* Variety of 401K options including a match program with no vesture period
* Annual Continuing Education Allowance (in related field)
* Life Insurance
* Short/Long Term Disability
* Paid maternity/paternity leave
* Mental Health Day
* *Calm* subscription for all employees

* **Experience:** 5\+ years of related experience (healthcare, payer operations, systems analysis, or federal program support preferred)
* **Technical skills:** Requirements management, workflow/process modeling, EDI analysis, cross‑system integration validation, Jira/Confluence/Azure DevOps, and understanding of eligibility and claims systems

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**  

Through a partnership\-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. With an innovative quoting platform that delivers accurate pricing and bindable quotes in less than one minute, Coterie makes small business insurance effortless.  

  

We are on a mission to build and foster a world\-class team to bring speed, simplicity, and service to commercial insurance. We value integrity, humility, passion, and intelligence. If you want to push yourself and reshape a $200B\+ market, we’re excited to talk to you!

 **Position Summary:**


Data is at the foundation of Coterie's business. We are looking for a Data Analyst who is curious, collaborative, and skilled at turning complex information into clear business insights. This role will use data analysis, statistical and quantitative methods, dashboards, forecasting, and fact\-based storytelling to help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make better decisions.  

You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, analysts, insurance subject matter experts, and business partners across Coterie. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who cares deeply about data quality, can connect analysis to business outcomes, and is comfortable moving between recurring reporting, ad hoc analysis, data queries and forward\-looking modeling. **Key Responsibilities**

* Contribute directly to data transformation and modeling in Gold and Platinum Medallion layers, using proficient SQL skills.
* Establish and evolve analytics best practices around metric definition, data integrity, and scalable solutions.
* Partner with subject matter experts across divisions including but not limited to Insurance, Revenue and Operations, to translate business needs into scalable analytics solutions and visualizations.
* Support other business areas through analysis focused on portfolio segmentation, loss experience, partner performance, underwriting, and renewal behaviors.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Data Science, Actuarial Science, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Three or more years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or a related role.
* Strong SQL skills and experience querying, joining, validating, and analyzing complex datasets.
* Experience building recurring reports, analytical datasets, and complex formulas using modern data tools.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, integrity, and documentation.
* Strong critical\-thinking, creative problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
* Experience working with insurance\-related data, such as loss experience, premium production, underwriting or operational metrics.


**Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Experience):**

* Experience with Databricks or related modern cloud analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with Python or R for custom report generation, exploratory data analyses, data visualization, or predictive modeling.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or data visualization tools.
* Advanced degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Data Science, Actuarial Science, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Intimate knowledge of commercial insurance

Our hiring process generally consists of 4 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well!

* Provide subject matter expertise on **U.S. regulatory frameworks**, interpreting rules and guidance from the Federal Reserve, OCC, FDIC, SEC, and FINRA.
* Perform data analysis, source\-to\-target mapping, reconciliation, and variance analysis to ensure reporting accuracy and completeness.
* Support user acceptance testing, production parallel runs, and go\-live activities.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior Business Analyst**

**About the Role \& Team**


Disney’s Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC) team oversees the Hulu and Disney\+ streaming businesses within the Disney Entertainment segment, helping bring The Walt Disney Company’s best\-in\-class storytelling to fans and families everywhere.


At Disney DTC, data is central to measuring every aspect of the business and critical to its continued operations and growth. Within the Business Operations function, the Executive Reporting \& Business Insights team is a highly visible group that works closely with DTC executives and stakeholders across the organization to support the consistent collection, use, and presentation of business\-critical KPIs and data points.


The team focuses on communicating and improving business results through data analysis, compelling presentation materials, and fast\-paced execution, with an emphasis on delivering actionable business insights and recommendations.


We are seeking a **Senior Business Analyst** to join our Business Insights team. This position requires exceptional attention to detail, a high level of accountability, strong collaboration skills, hands\-on experience working with complex datasets, and a talent for storytelling with data.

**What You Will Do**


As a **Senior Business Analyst**, you will conduct data analysis, extract meaningful insights, and create high\-level presentations for executive audiences. You will formulate key business questions, determine the most effective methods for addressing them, and present insights in a way that enables senior executives to make informed decisions.

**Responsibilities**

* **Business Performance Reporting, Visualization, and Regression Management:** Serve as a primary partner to cross\-functional stakeholders by identifying when metrics are ahead of or behind expectations. Conduct in\-depth analysis to uncover meaningful, actionable insights that can improve business performance or help the organization build upon its successes.
* **Deep\-Dive Analysis:** Analyze user behavioral data to identify patterns, uncover opportunities, and build a shared understanding of how users interact with the platform and its content.
* **Forecasting and Opportunity Sizing:** Use forecasting and opportunity\-sizing methodologies to establish goals and evaluate potential business opportunities. Help stakeholders assess trade\-offs among different approaches and develop targets that drive business performance.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Partner closely with business stakeholders to identify and unlock opportunities. Collaborate with other data teams to improve platform capabilities related to data modeling, testing platforms, data visualization, and data architecture.
* **Executive Communication:** Develop impactful and compelling presentation materials, including decks, notes, written summaries, and supporting materials, that clearly communicate key findings and help influence important operational decisions.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* 5\+ years of analytical experience.
* 2\+ years of experience working cross\-functionally with stakeholders in a matrixed organization.
* Strong familiarity with data platforms and applications such as Databricks, Jupyter, Snowflake, Redshift, and Airflow.
* Familiarity with data exploration and visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, and Chartio.
* Strong experience defining data requirements, data strategies, and data rules, including standardization, cleansing, and validation.
* Outstanding interpersonal and written communication skills.
* Ability to visualize and summarize data insights into clear, compelling, and actionable business narratives, including written memos and executive presentations.
* Strong analytical and technical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, quickly develop potential solutions, document changes, and communicate those changes across the organization.
* Ability to evaluate risks and provide timely recommendations and solutions.
* Ability to think strategically and analyze and interpret market and consumer information.
* Understanding of statistical concepts, including hypothesis testing and regression analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in the streaming media industry or knowledge of data related to Video on Demand (VOD) and subscription video\-on\-demand (SVOD) services.
* Experience compiling and presenting detailed analyses to executive audiences.
* Project management experience.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field, such as Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, is desired.

**Additional Information**

* This role is based in the New York City office and requires in\-office work Monday through Thursday, with flexibility to work from home on Fridays.

  


The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $112,000\.00 \- $150,100\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Counterintelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**


DARPAs All\-Source intelligence/counterintelligence (CI) program includes detecting, identifying, assessing, and, in conjunction with the assigned CI support activity, analyzing information on adversary intentions and capabilities. This may include developing programs, systems, and procedures designed to counter foreign intelligence collection efforts and activities of foreign entities, including sabotage and terrorist activities.


All\-Source/CI analysts recommend cost\-effective protective measures and countermeasures for DARPA personnel, programs, and activities. All\-Source/CI Analyst will enable DARPAs organic intelligence/CI program to realize the positive attributes inherent in combining IC resources with a trained/qualified internal multi\-disciplined security team in applying All\-Source Intelligence/CI context to protecting DARPA programs. This nascent internal structure will develop or adapt existing programs, systems, and procedures to proactively counter foreign intelligence collection efforts and activities, including sabotage and terrorist activities.


The All\-Source/CI Analyst will perform the following responsibilities:

* Determine essential elements of information, and conduct activities to detect, identify, assess, exploit, and proactively counter or neutralize hostile intelligence collection, sabotage, and terrorist activities
* Plan special analytical projects in response to client assignments which include analytical approach, schedule, personnel requirements, data collection, travel, assessment criteria, and costs
* Research and collect required data, perform analysis, and summarize findings in response to client requests
* Compile detailed reports of analysis clearly defining the problem or issue, factors considered, findings, and provide clear, concise conclusions and recommendations
* Develop innovative and proactive analytical methodologies, refining existing program protection analytical methodologies to meet evolving program needs
* Provide intelligence/CI input and assist PSRs, PMs, and SETAs in developing Program Protection Plans
* Review and provide comments on Program Protection Plans, Test Plans, OPSEC Plans, and other planning documentation as required
* Assist Technical Office management, PMs, SETAs, and security personnel in performing SAP lifecycle threat analysis
* Apply analytical methodologies to existing programs to review, and readdress, if necessary, their protection needs to remain consistent with changes in diplomatic, political, and military environments
* Perform short\-notice contingency and exposure analysis, summarizing implications, and providing viable responses and recommended courses of action
* Work with individual program management personnel to assist in analyzing and developing solutions to unique or difficult CI\-related issues
* Review organizational mission statements and associated publicly available information for inconsistencies which may reveal sensitive information
* Review, analyze, and, where appropriate, make recommendations to long\-term program protection policies and practices
* Provide intelligence and CI threat data and analysis to support assessments and surveys of agency\-wide OPSEC programs
* Assist DARPA PMs in identification of program CPI and assist in the development of agency\-wide and program\-specific OPSEC plans, and make recommendations for additions or changes where appropriate
* Participate, as appropriate, in program management and planning meetings, and working sessions to provide an intelligence/CI perspective
* Receive information of CI value from technical security inspections, foreign travel reporting, international relations/security, visitor control, AT/FP, or other sources of potential FIE or CI related activity
* Prepare and deliver comprehensive briefings to increase CI awareness and to inform senior DARPA leadership
* Establish lines of communication and professional relationships with other Federal and DoD agencies within the IC
* Other duties as assigned




**Required Skills (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities)**

* Understanding the Intelligence Community composition, including the roles and responsibilities of the IC components; methodologies inherent in Insider Threats; elicitation methods and procedures; counter\-elicitation methods and procedures; CI indicators of motivation; methods of information collection and information transmittal; the basics and methodologies employed in Competitive Intelligence and Economic Espionage practices; foreign intelligence/CI threat data and the agencies acquiring it (including general, site specific, and technical); implications to DARPA program efforts from various threats; and understanding, prioritizing, and counteracting threats.
* Attend meetings (either locally or out\-of\-area) and create meeting summaries or trip reports
* Prepare and submit meeting minutes on an as\-required basis
* Prepare/present briefings, incorporating graphics (if appropriate) for/to SID and DARPA leaders
* Prepare various security forms associated with their duties
* Assist in entry control and perform escort duties for visitors
* Answer telephones and other modes of administrative communications in the performance of duties
* Perform self\-inspections, identify security discrepancies, and report security incidents
* Perform, or support, security inspections, identify security discrepancies and prepare reports
* Perform courier duties within the continental United States (CONUS)
* Perform user\-level security administrator and information security responsibilities as required and in compliance with US Codes, Executive Orders, and DoD and DARPA policy
* Perform objective reviews on all documentation encountered during performance of duties
* Possess the energy, experience, and subject matter expertise to demonstrate sound judgment, foresight and problem\-solving skills in a fast\-paced S\&T RDT\&E environment
* Possess excellent organizational

jobs.title: Counterintelligence & Security Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Counterintelligence (CI) and Security Investigations Team's safeguards Anduril's workforce and supply chain by proactively identifying risk, mitigating threats and delivering actionable investigative insights*.*The team helps ensure our security environment remains vigilant and resilient so that our strategic interests are preserved. We are committed to anticipating and mitigating risks and threats enabling Anduril to innovate and operate confidently in a dynamic global environment.

  

### **ABOUT THE POSITION**



Anduril is seeking a professional to support the CI and Security Investigations team in a unique opportunity to help strategize, socialize and implement a CI and security risk program that requires significant critical thinking, creativity, complex problem solving and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to work across a rapidly growing, global, dynamic organization to identify and mitigate threats. The Counterintelligence \& Security Risk Analyst Lead is responsible for analyzing threats from nation state actors and insiders affecting Anduril's workforce, technologies and supply chain globally. The role will involve the development and support of analytic efforts and work\-streams that integrate across key business processes and stakeholders, spanning people vetting, supplier and vendor risk, and enterprise CI analysis, to enable rapid mitigation and informed decision making. This position will leverage a variety of internal and external data sets and tools to develop a robust understanding of the threat environment. The Analyst must be a self\-starter that can operate independently and be responsive to fast paced and dynamic operational and threat environments, and must possess a deep understanding of CI, intelligence analysis, risk management, and a demonstrated ability to analyze and communicate complex risks and threats.

  

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Support the development of CI analysis tailored to the defense industry's unique threats and requirements, spanning workforce, technology and supply chain risk.
* Analyze threats from nation state actors, reviewing data from multiple sources to identify anomalous behaviors and other indicators.
* Execute workforce, visitor and supplier vetting initiatives, conducting thorough risk assessments and initial investigations to ensure Anduril is engaging with trusted people and vendors.
* Support a repeatable, scalable process for vetting of candidates, visitors, suppliers and vendors, and continuously monitor existing relationships for emerging risks.
* Coordinate with federal agencies, including the Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), and Federal Law Enforcement, to access relevant threat information and stay current on evolving adversary tactics, techniques and procedures.
* Establish and leverage collaborative partnerships across internal stakeholders, including product, supply chain, legal, HR, and InfoSec teams, to identify data necessary to support robust research and analysis.
* Produce tailored and strategic risk assessments, detailed reports and presentations on findings, case studies, threat assessments, and recommended actions for multiple audiences to include senior leadership.
* Develop and implement analytic methodologies to assess counterintelligence, supplier and people related risks.
* Provide analytic support to investigations.
* Support the development of procedures, processes, risk frameworks and documentation that comply with government regulations and contractual obligations, and produce key metrics for leadership on a recurring basis.
* Monitor, analyze and communicate trends in people or supplier risk and nation state\-related risk and threats to help shape vetting and mitigation initiatives.
* Support the development of training and awareness materials and present tailored briefings to internal audiences.
* Travel as needed to support risk assessments at various Anduril site locations or external events.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Security or Intelligence Studies, Political Science, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
* 8 years of relevant work experience in CI analysis, intelligence operations or analysis, or people and supplier risk vetting, assessing complex threats from nation state actors and other nation state\-related risk.
* Experience conducting risk and threat assessments and presenting analysis to inform executive decision making.
* Demonstrated ability leveraging multiple data sets and tools to support complex research and analysis, as well as developing risk assessments and risk mitigation recommendations.
* Experience conducting public record research and investigations (e.g., criminal, civil, financial, corporate, property, licensing, or court records) in support of people and supplier vetting, or CI\-related assessments.
* Ability to synthesize public record findings with open\-source and other data sets to assess credibility, relevance, and risk, and communicate findings to technical and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with CI risk assessment methodologies and CI threat analysis.
* Experience leveraging critical thinking skills to creatively solve complex problem

Job ID: 2616499

**Location:** Alexandria, VA, US

**Date Posted:** 2026\-09\-03

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Project Analyst

**Schedule:** Full\-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes \- 10% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** TS.SCI

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

 **Description**


SAIC is seeking an **Economic Security Analyst** to support our team of qualified, diverse, and highly motivated individuals supporting the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering (OUSW(R\&E)). The qualified candidate will provide analytical support to S\&T Program Protection Office, responsible for support the protection of critical and emerging technologies by evaluating mergers, acquisitions, exports, and foreign investment. **The position is on site in Alexandria, VA.**

**Job duties include:**

* Identify business relationships such as contracts, licensing agreements, and board memberships to analyze; raw material acquisition, technology transfer and delivery, supply chain dynamics including sole source entities, reliance on foreign sources of manufacturing or raw materials, and patents related to DoW technology modernization areas
* Analyze traditional and non\-traditional supply chains to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for exploitation
* Business and social network analysis to illuminate networks of individuals, financial and non\-financial business activities, technology trends, academic partnerships and research collaborations
* Formulate risk mitigation strategies to address technology and technical stakeholder interests
* Produce analytical and technical assessments for S\&T PP and greater R\&E programs, sometimes with short notice and ambiguous requirements
* Refine and develop (as needed) SOPs, guides, and templates for conducting due diligence analysis across S\&T PP programs


**Qualifications**


**Required Qualifications:**

* Active TS/SCI clearance and US citizenship.
* Bachelors and ten (10\) years or more of related experience; Masters and eight (8\) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and five (5\) years or more experience.
* Strong leadership, problem identification/resolution skills, flexibility, initiative, and a proven ability to work with Senior Executives efficiently and effectively.
* Expertise in export control policies and best practices.
* Advanced knowledge in emerging technology, industrial policy, and international affairs (preferably all three).
* Knowledge of the DoW acquisition processes, policies, and guidance.
* Analytic ability – must demonstrate ability to conduct technical analysis linking intelligence, acquisition, engineering/technical information. Analytic ability may be demonstrated with any combination of work products and education.
* Demonstrated ability to provide timely and accurate information to senior government officials in support of policy and management decisions.
* Experience using large language models (LLMs) to assist in daily work.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Proficient in MS Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of DoW systems engineering practices, such as technology decomposition and criticality analysis.
* Knowledge of blue\-mapping and supply chain risk management practices.
* Knowledge of Business Intelligence (BI) and social network analysis practices, tools, and processes.
* Knowledge of Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD) organizational structures, functions, and communication protocols.
* Knowledge in one or more of the DoD technology modernization areas.
* Advanced analytical skills (such as R or Python).
* Post\-graduate research experience and/or military experience.


Target salary range: $160,001 \- $200,000\. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description:
Job ID: 2616506

**Location:** Washington, DC, US

**Date Posted:** 2026\-09\-03

**Category:** Cyber

**Subcategory:** Cyber Engineer

**Schedule:** Full\-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** No

**Minimum Clearance Required:** None

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** Public Trust

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_HYBRID

 **Description**


SAIC is looking for a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst supports Security Operations functions while helping establish and mature the organization's offensive security capability in support of a critical U.S. Government agency.


This position is responsible for advanced incident detection, investigation, response, threat analysis, and security monitoring across on\-premises and cloud environments. In addition to traditional SOC responsibilities, the analyst performs authorized offensive security activities, including manual vulnerability validation, reproduction of penetration test findings, remediation verification, and security control validation to identify and validate security weaknesses requiring manual analysis beyond automated vulnerability scanning.


The position supports the development of repeatable security validation processes and the agency's evolving offensive security capability, which may expand over time to include application security assessments, adversary emulation, and purple team activities.

**ONSITE 3 Days / Remote 2 days – Washington DC**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Monitor, analyze, investigate, and respond to cybersecurity alerts and incidents using SIEM, endpoint detection and response (EDR), network monitoring, email security, identity security, and other enterprise security technologies.
* Perform advanced incident triage to determine scope, impact, attack vectors, and recommend appropriate containment, eradication, recovery, and mitigation activities.
* Analyze network traffic, endpoint telemetry, authentication events, application logs, system logs, and threat intelligence to identify malicious activity and indicators of compromise.
* Lead or support investigations involving phishing, malware, unauthorized access, insider threats, data exposure, and other cybersecurity events.
* Develop, maintain, and improve incident response procedures, investigative workflows, technical documentation, and response playbooks.
* Review, assign, document, and track cybersecurity incidents and operational activities using approved ticketing and documentation systems.
* Support investigations involving DHS, CISA, US\-CERT, vendor advisories, and other cybersecurity notifications affecting agency systems.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to junior cybersecurity analysts.
* Conduct authorized offensive security activities, including manual vulnerability validation, reproduction of penetration test findings, remediation verification, and security control validation.
* Perform recurring validation testing of known vulnerabilities and security deficiencies to verify exploitability, assess technical impact, and confirm remediation effectiveness.
* Perform manual testing of applications, APIs, identity services, wireless technologies, and other designated systems using approved security assessment tools and methodologies.
* Distinguish confirmed vulnerabilities from false positives, configuration issues, environmental conditions, and non\-exploitable findings, and document technical evidence, remediation recommendations, and validation results.
* Develop repeatable testing procedures, validation methodologies, assessment documentation, and technical guidance to support recurring security validation activities.
* Collaborate with Security Operations, Patch and Vulnerability Management, application teams, infrastructure teams, system owners, and external assessors to improve the agency's overall security posture.
* Identify opportunities to improve security monitoring, detection logic, logging, defensive controls, and incident response based on manual security assessment results.
* Research emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and offensive security techniques to support continuous improvement of organizational cybersecurity capabilities.
* Support the continued development of internal offensive security, application security, adversary emulation, and purple team capabilities while performing all activities within approved authorization, scope, rules of engagement, and operational safeguards.


**Qualifications**


**Qualifications \& Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Additional relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
* Five or more years of experience in cybersecurity operations, Security Operations Center (SOC) activities, incident response, vulnerability management, security engineering, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust requiring U.S. Citizenship or Green Card.
* Demonstrated experience investigating, analyzing, and responding to cybersecurity incidents.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, attack methodologies, common threat vectors, and NIST incident response guidance.
* Experience analyzing network traffic, endpoint telemetry, authentication activity, application logs, system logs, and threat indicators.
* Experience with enterprise cybersecurity technologies, including SIEM, EDR, email security, identity security, privileged access management, and threat intelligence platforms.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication protocols, Windows, Linux, cloud environments, enterprise networking, and common application architectures.
* Understanding of web applications, APIs, authentication, authorization, session management, and common application security vulnerabilities.

jobs.title: Senior System Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior System Security Analyst**  

Remote


Blu Omega is seeking a Senior System Security Analyst to support a federal cybersecurity program focused on safeguarding critical health systems and data. This role operates within a fully remote environment and is responsible for maintaining and enhancing enterprise cybersecurity defenses across the NIH Cybersecurity Operations Center. The position requires experience supporting federal cybersecurity standards and technical operations in a mission\-driven environment.


**Program Overview**  

Supporting NIH cybersecurity operations to protect federal health data and systems through 24/7 enterprise security monitoring and threat response.


**Key Details**  

Location: Remote (badging locations in Bethesda, MD; Raleigh, NC; Hamilton, MT)
  

Clearance: NIH Public Trust, ability to obtain and maintain suitability


**Responsibilities**  

* Continuously monitor and analyze system security to identify vulnerabilities, threats, and potential breaches.
* Conduct risk assessments and system audits to uncover security gaps.
* Recommend and implement mitigation strategies to enhance system security.
* Collaborate with IT and cybersecurity teams to embed security best practices into architecture and operations.
* Keep up\-to\-date with emerging cyber threats and adjust security measures proactively.
* Support 24/7 cybersecurity operations to ensure ongoing detection, response, and protection in compliance with federal standards.

**Required Qualifications**  

* 3\+ years of cybersecurity experience, focusing on system security analysis.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring tools like Splunk and endpoint security solutions such as Microsoft Defender.
* Familiarity with incident response and intrusion detection techniques.
* Understanding of federal cybersecurity frameworks including FISMA and NIST.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to operate independently in a remote setting and collaborate with diverse teams.
* Ability to support 2nd or 3rd shift (4 PM \- 12 AM EST or 12 AM \- 8 AM EST).
* Must be able to obtain and maintain NIH Public Trust clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, or Security\+ are highly advantageous.
* Experience supporting government agency IT operations within health or federal environments.
* Knowledge of security architecture, system virtualization, and multi\-cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Tenable, DbProtect, and advanced threat detection methods.

**Compensation**  

Salary Range: $63,000\.00 \- $83,798\.56
  

Final compensation based on skills, experience, education, certifications, and clearance.


**Blu Omega Benefits \& Perks**  

Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage through national providers
  

401(k) with company match (eligible after 6 months; vesting applies)
  

Company\-paid Life and AD\&D insurance with additional voluntary options
  

Short\-term and long\-term disability options
  

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 confidential support and mental health resources
  

Telehealth and virtual care options
  

Pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection options
  

Paid Time Off (PTO) and federal holidays for salaried employees
  

Access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits


**Company Overview**  

Blu Omega is a Woman\-Owned Small Business (WOSB) delivering cybersecurity and technology solutions to federal agencies. Headquartered in Ashburn, VA, we support mission\-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, including health, national security, and regulatory environments. We partner with government agencies to provide expertise in cybersecurity operations, cloud and infrastructure modernization, data and analytics, and enterprise IT support.


**Equal Opportunity Employment**  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: Ground Systems Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

BAE Systems Intelligence \& Security division is seeking a Ground Systems Analyst to join our team in Quantico, VA in support of a Maritime effort for (MAGIC) Marine Corps Intelligence Activity Analysis, Geospatial Imagery, and Counterintelligence Support Services program.
  

  

What is it like working for a company that helps governments recognize, manage, and defeat threats? Exciting, invigorating and satisfying.
  

  

The candidate will provide direct support to MCIA to provide situational awareness and intelligence production and analysis for numerous AORs. Candidate will conduct analysis using intelligence and information from multiple sources to assess, interpret, forecast, and explain a range of national security issues and developments that are regional or functional in nature. Provides all\-source analytic support to collections, operations, investigations, and other defense intelligence analytic requirements.
  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* At least 8 years of relevant experience with a portion of that experience being within the last 2 years.
* Bachelor's degree in an area related to the field of work
* Conduct All\-Source analytic production of foreign military ground systems including, but not limited to, platforms, sensors, motor transport, armor, anti\-armor, artillery, firearms, explosives, logistical and maintenance, readiness, and missions.
* Analyze and assess current and future foreign missile technology to include but not limited to foreign missile system capabilities, vulnerabilities, advanced weapon systems, technical data analysis, and tactics, techniques, and procedures.
* Analyze foreign precision weapon systems and indirect fire weapon platforms to forecast future technologies, identify new applications of mature technologies, and assess the impact of technology transfers.
* Work with engineers, scientists, and/or modelers on foreign weapons processes, capabilities, and dual\-use technologies.

Analyzes and assesses current and future foreign, lethal and non\-lethal, weapon systems including, but not limited to, system capabilities, vulnerabilities, production, stockpile, deployment, proliferation, and impact to U.S. and Coalition forces worldwide  
* 

  

  

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Customer is requesting a seasoned Intelligence Analyst preferably with multi\-INT expertise, excellent research, writing, and briefing skills to customer senior leadership, as they pertain to an intelligence environment supporting critical operations. .
  

  

  

**Pay Information**
  

Full\-Time Salary Range: $97008 \- $164914
  

  

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  

  

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  

  

  

  

**About BAE Systems Intelligence \& Security**  

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  

  

Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  

  

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: Human Capital Data Analyst
jobs.description:

DarkStar Intelligence is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Human Capital Data Analyst to support a critical National Security program. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience analyzing workforce data, building data visualizations, and providing analytic support for various human capital initiatives. This position requires a deep understanding of data analysis tools, the ability to communicate findings clearly, and a strong background in workforce analytics.

 **Responsibilities**

* Analyze workforce data, including metrics related to hiring, retention, attrition, and organizational mobility, to identify trends and labor projections.
* Build and modify data visualization dashboards, reports, and other analytical products to meet client needs.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of position description libraries to standardize role information across the organization.
* Administer and manage relational databases, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
* Normalize, standardize, and integrate disparate raw data sets for consistent analysis.
* Support survey design and execution across 18 Intelligence Community (IC) agencies.
* Provide data analytic support for surveys, data calls, and other human capital efforts, ensuring accurate and timely insights.
* Manage HR data and conduct thorough analysis to support workforce planning and decision\-making processes.


Requirements:
* BA/BS degree and 5\+ years of relevant experience or no degree and 9\+ years of experience.
* TS/SCI with Polygraph clearance is required.
* Prior experience in data analysis within the Intelligence Community (IC).
* Strong ability to communicate technical or analytical findings in an easily understandable format through graphic, written, and verbal means.
* **Core Tools:** Advanced proficiency in Excel, Tableau, and relational database management is required.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Cognos for reporting and dashboarding.
* Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
* Familiarity with additional tools such as VBA, R, SPSS, SAS, LimeSurvey, Personal Operations Portal (POPS), PD Library, and Lawson.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Everforth ECS is seeking a ***Technical Project Manager*** to join our team in ***Arlington, VA (Hybrid)***. This position is contingent upon award.





We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager (TPM) to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex technology initiatives across the organization. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, engineering teams, cybersecurity professionals, and executive leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with strategic objectives.



The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise with a solid technical background, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple cross\-functional initiatives in fast\-paced environments.





**Key Responsibilities**





**Project Planning \& Delivery**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, from initiation through implementation and operational transition.
* Develop project charters, schedules, work breakdown structures, resource plans, and budgets.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
* Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to quality standards.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects with varying complexity and priorities.


**Stakeholder Management**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, leadership teams, and delivery partners.
* Facilitate project meetings, steering committees, and executive status reviews.
* Communicate project progress, risks, issues, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders.
* Align technical teams and business partners around project goals and priorities.


**Technical Program Coordination**


* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, and application development teams.
* Coordinate solution design, system implementations, migrations, and technology deployments.
* Ensure technical requirements are understood and translated into actionable project plans.
* Support architecture reviews and technical decision\-making processes.


**Risk \& Issue Management**


* Identify, track, and mitigate project risks and dependencies.
* Escalate critical issues and facilitate resolution among stakeholders.
* Manage scope changes through established governance and change control processes.
* Conduct impact assessments related to technical, operational, and business risks.


**Agile \& Project Management Practices**


* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement when applicable.
* Manage project execution using Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid methodologies.
* Support Scrum teams in removing impediments and maintaining delivery momentum.
* Drive continuous improvement of project management standards and delivery practices.


**Reporting \& Governance**
